annotation.evidence_span: MAY treat non-zero padding as a connection error
annotation.interpretation_a: The receiver can choose to treat non-zero padding as an error, but is not required to.
annotation.interpretation_b: The receiver can choose to ignore non-zero padding without treating it as an error.
annotation.justification: The MAY keyword allows for two reasonable interpretations: either the receiver can treat non-zero padding as an error, or it can ignore it. There is no constraint on *how* the receiver makes this choice, or what conditions would cause it to choose one behavior over the other. This creates ambiguity in implementation.
